title: cyperus pumilus var. mutica
intro: Cyperus pumilus var. mutica, commonly known as Dwarf Papyrus, is a type of sedge plant native to Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Papyrus include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial effects. It is rich in bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
